Dataset Card for Self-Bench
	


	
		
	
	
		Overview
	

Self-Bench is a diagnostic benchmark designed to explore the relationship between the generative and discriminative capabilities of diffusion models. It consists of images generated by different diffusion models, enabling controlled evaluations where the image domain is well-defined and consistent.
